scope: Derwent Valley councillor resignation and TEC recount process.

sources.title: TEC local government vacancies
sources.finding: The Derwent Valley notice names councillor Michelle Dracoulis and dates her resignation to 16 November. Unsuccessful 2026 ordinary election candidates were contacted and must consent by noon 30 November.

sources.title: TEC homepage
sources.finding: The commission’s front page also identifies the current Derwent Valley councillor recount.

sources.title: TEC 2026 Derwent Valley results index
sources.finding: The results index reports seven councillor positions and completed counting. The detailed result tabs did not expose their rows in the available text view.

sources.title: Derwent Valley Council elected members directory
sources.finding: The available directory still lists the pre-election names and titles, including Dracoulis as mayor.

limits: Candidate consent is a separate deadline. No recount instant, participant consent, winning candidate or individual current officeholder is verified.
